name: Medo Persian Kingdom
overview: The Medo Persian Kingdom, as revealed in Scripture, was established under the leadership of Cyrus king of Persia, who was divinely stirred by the LORD to make a proclamation allowing the Jewish people to return to Jerusalem and rebuild the temple. This kingdom is portrayed as a sovereign instrument in God's plan, having been given all the kingdoms of the earth by the LORD God of heaven, as emphasized in the proclamations recorded in 2 Chronicles and Ezra. The historical significance of this kingdom includes the deliverance of the Jews from captivity and the fulfillment of God's promises through the leadership of Cyrus.
